CustomField.description: BRME-7038: Formula field that renders clickable hyperlinks to the Final Memo, Budget Narrative, and Approval Email documents on the Final Docs tab. Each link opens in a new browser tab and is omitted from the output when its URL field is blank.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Final_Memo_Link__c)), HYPERLINK(Final_Memo_Link__c, "Final Memo", "_blank") & BR(), "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Budget_Narrative_Link__c)), HYPERLINK(Budget_Narrative_Link__c, "Budget Narrative", "_blank") & BR(), "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Approval_Email_Link__c)), HYPERLINK(Approval_Email_Link__c, "Email confirmation of Approval", "_blank"), "")
CustomField.label: View Required Docs
